hero.eyebrow: Undetectable browser use for AI agents
hero.headline: Give your AI the keys to the internet.
hero.lede: Weles turns authorized browser workflows into an API. It combines patched Chromium and Firefox builds, rotating fingerprints, cached trajectories, scoped credentials, recordings, and signed receipts.
hero.metaDescription: Weles gives AI agents reliable, authorized browser access with patched browsers, cached trajectories, scoped credentials, recordings, and signed receipts.

sections.heading: AI can write your software. It still gets stuck at the login page.
sections.lede: Ordinary browser agents expose automation signals, rediscover the same interface on every run, lose sessions, and leave you guessing when a workflow fails.

items.title: Detected
items.text: Stock automation surfaces announce the agent before it reaches the work.

items.title: Slow
items.text: The same navigation is rediscovered and paid for again on every run.

items.title: Unclear
items.text: A failed action without a recording or terminal state gives you no exact point to repair.

sections.heading: One authorized action. One reviewed path. One recorded result.
sections.lede: Weles separates authorization, execution, credentials, and evidence so a browser workflow can become a production capability instead of an unowned script.

items.title: Authorize
items.text: Submit the exact origin, action, justification, idempotency key, and credential references.

items.title: Resolve
items.text: Weles selects the reviewed trajectory and the verified Chromium or Firefox artifact.

items.title: Execute
items.text: The worker replays the route with a coherent browser identity and scoped credentials from Skarbiec.

items.title: Prove
items.text: The action closes with terminal state, retained evidence, and—when configured—a signed receipt verified offline.

sections.heading: The browser can reach a page. That does not grant permission to automate it.

items.question: Does Weles authorize automation of a target?
items.answer: No. Authorization remains with the operator and every production submission must name its exact origin, action, and justification.

items.question: Do passwords enter the agent prompt?
items.answer: No. Credentials resolve through scoped Skarbiec grants and are kept out of prompts and logs.

items.question: Is the source public or only the client?
items.answer: The executor, client, patched-browser repositories, and benchmark are public. The operated service adds provisioning, reviewed trajectories, evidence retention, and support.

sections.heading: Turn the next browser workflow into an API.
sections.lede: Start with one exact origin and one exact action. Weles turns the approved journey into a repeatable trajectory with bounded credentials and recorded evidence.
